{{Otheruses|unidentified bounty hunter}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
[[0 ABY/Legends|Six]] [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], an unsavory '''bounty hunter''' gave a tip to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The tip led the Imperials to launch an [[Ambush at Mos Eisley|attack]] on the [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], in order to root out their target, [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="RS I guide">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron: The Official Nintendo Player's Guide]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] was mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron: The Official Nintendo Player's Guide|''Official Nintendo Player's Guide'']] released in [[1998]] for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']].<ref name="RS I guide" />
